channel.title: Blog — practical writing on IT for business | BagTech
channel.description: The BagTech blog: practical articles on software development, AI, cybersecurity, CRM/ERP, system integration and websites for business.

item.title: What is an MVP and why your project should start with one
item.description: Building a big system in one go looks tempting, but it is the most expensive route. How to choose the first version, what to leave for later and when to grow.

item.title: Face recognition in the office: how it works and where the data stays
item.description: Cards get lost, passwords are forgotten and attendance sheets are filled in by hand. How face recognition solves this and what it takes to keep the data safe.

item.title: Cybersecurity for small and mid-sized businesses: the first 10 steps
item.description: Most attacks start with a weak password or unpatched software, not with sophisticated technology. Ten practical steps that do not require a big budget.

item.title: CRM or ERP: which one does your company need?
item.description: CRM and ERP are often confused. We explain how they differ, when you need each one, and how to choose between a ready-made platform and a custom-built system.

item.title: How to stop copying data by hand: an introduction to system integration
item.description: An order comes in from the website, the accountant retypes it, the warehouse keeps its own spreadsheet. How APIs, webhooks and sound design change that picture.

item.title: Why is your website slow? 7 technical checks for speed and SEO
item.description: A slow website loses both customers and positions in search. Seven common causes of slow loading that you can check yourself, and how to fix each one.
